name: Shirakawa (Gifu, Japan, town)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shirakawa town emblem in white: a disc pierced by a stylised flame-like device.
history: Municipal flag of Shirakawa, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 May 1963.

features.role: Shirakawa town emblem — a disc pierced by a stylised flame-like device
